protocol_metadata.about: Mantle Index Four (MI4) is an institutional-grade tokenized fund structured as a BVI Limited Partnership and managed by Mantle Guard Limited. The fund provides diversified exposure to major cryptocurrencies (BTC 50%, ETH 28%, SOL 7%, USD 15%) with enhanced yields through DeFi-native staking strategies (mETH, bbSOL, sUSDe). Tokenized on Mantle Network via Securitize, MI4 serves as a regulated fund wrapper bringing traditional finance infrastructure to crypto beta investment, with Fireblocks custody and multi-signature controls.
